items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: but he played with me two weeks and he couldn't make the grades

ctx.x: Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. Harry's a clarinet. Yeah. Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. He was older than Harry. And he came on up there and he couldn't fit into the rhythm. We kept him two weeks to make enough money to go back home. We tried on every song platter. We wouldn't go to London England. I had already signed a contract with the Morris Agency. We'd go to London to open the Joy Bells Theater. And out of a clear sky after trying to bounce, you know, I had Sidney Lansfield sit in the band.…
And, uh, I hate to ask this. This is embarrassing to him, I know, but what did you require of a piano player that he couldn't play?
